title: Strictly Henselian Ind-étale algebras and points of an affine spectral Deligne-Mumford stack
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.1.6: let A be an E-infinity ring, B an Ind-étale A-algebra, and eta*: S subset P((CAlg_A^et)^op) the geometric morphism determined by B. Conditions (1) eta* factors through Shv((CAlg_A^et)^op) and (2) B is strictly Henselian are equivalent.

context_spans.label: Set-up of points of Spec(A), Shv((CAlg_A^et)^op), and Ind-étale A-algebras

standard_prerequisites: Infinity-topos theory and points/geometric morphisms; Proposition T.6.2.3.20 in Lurie, Higher Topos Theory.
The structure theorem for étale morphisms of E-infinity rings, Proposition VII.8.10 in DAG VII.
Proposition 1.1.3 characterizing strictly Henselian E-infinity rings (author PDF pp. 5-6).
Filtered colimits and compactness of étale A-algebras, Corollary A.7.5.4.4.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because, beyond a citation assembly, the author proof at author PDF pp. 6-7 contains a concrete filtered-colimit descent argument: it writes B as a filtered colimit of étale A-algebras B(beta), descends the finite étale maps B -> B_alpha to some B(beta) using Proposition VII.8.10, identifies the image as a quasi-compact open subset and radical ideal I, and uses faithful flatness plus change of index to make I the unit ideal before applying condition (*). This is non-routine research material but a supporting point criterion rather than the main H3 construction.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Filtered-colimit descent of finite étale covers and the faithful-flat radical-ideal argument proving the converse strict-Henselian condition.
